fixes.bug: Baseline failures at tests/autopilot-models.test.mjs lines 124 and 203 (cancel did not append the system note; cloud cancel omitted 'may have reached the cloud provider').
fixes.cause: On abort, readLines cancelled the reader. ReadableStreamDefaultReader.read() then reports a normal end (done:true), so the stream finished 'successfully': partial text came back as a complete reply and the user cancel (and an idle timeout) was never noticed.
fixes.fix: readLines now throws the abort reason when the signal is aborted, so ChatCancelled / TimeoutError surface correctly. Assertions were not weakened.

fixes.bug: A stream that ended without its end marker (Ollama done:true, Anthropic message_stop), e.g. a dropped connection, was returned as a complete reply.
fixes.fix: New exported ChatIncomplete(partial). The partial text is stored as an assistant message followed by a system note saying the reply is incomplete and whether the cloud provider may have the message. Cap-truncated replies still count as complete.

fixes.bug: A throwing onJob / onProfile observer in ModelRuntime would throw inside the background job runner (unhandled rejection, job left 'running') or undo setProfile.
fixes.fix: Observers are best-effort (private emit(); try/catch around onProfile).
